name: STRM Probe Optimizer
description: Optimize native probing for versioned video STRM files. Linux x64 only; tested on Jellyfin 12.2.0. Jellyfin 12.3 is not runtime-validated.
overview: STRM probe optimization — Linux x64 / Jellyfin 12.2

versions.changelog: First release. Native playback and scheduled checks, minimal fingerprints, shared probe concurrency; validated video decision and recovery scenarios.
